author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Complete genus-level Harpes living reconstruction with a broad horseshoe head brim and continuous rearward wings. The dorsal fossil exemplar supports the gross form; underside, soft tissues, nominal scale, palette and adult-like extended pose are conservative artistic choices, not exact species or specimen claims.
description.zh: 完整属级 Harpes 生活形态复原，保留马蹄形宽头缘及连续后掠翼；背面化石支持总体形态，腹面、软组织、名义尺度、颜色和伸展姿态为保守创作，不作精确种级或标本声明。
